**Probe-settled behaviour** (detail in spec/behaviour/sys-param.md): visible in every accepted configuration; MIN/MAX
choose b on ties and NaN, chosen operand evaluated twice; howmany y twice, a prior user howmany kept; roundup masks
for a compile-time power-of-two step (0 included), else divides with y evaluated 3 times; powerof2(0) is 1; setbit
and friends count in the array's own elements, isset gives the masked bit.
